# Vatican News

> > Official news portal of the Holy See providing comprehensive coverage of Pope Francis, the Catholic Church, and global humanitarian and religious affairs.

Vatican News (vaticannews.va) is the multimedia news service of the Holy See, offering news, analysis, and features about the Pope, the Vatican, Catholic Church activities worldwide, and the Church's engagement with peace, humanitarian aid, and social justice issues. The site covers papal activities, Vatican diplomacy, interfaith dialogue, and the Church's response to global crises.

## Key Topics

- Papa Francesco (Pope Francis)
- Santa Sede (Holy See)
- Chiesa Cattolica (Catholic Church)
- Cardinale Zuppi
- Margaret Karram
- Focolari Movement
- Pace (Peace)
- Aiuti Umanitari (Humanitarian Aid)
- Medio Oriente (Middle East)
- Rifugiati (Refugees)
- Libano (Lebanon)
- Cuba
- Terra dei Fuochi
- Vatican diplomacy
- Interfaith dialogue

## Main News Portal

- [Vatican News - Notizie sul Papa sul Vaticano e sulla Chiesa - Vatican News](https://www.vaticannews.va/it.html): Homepage with latest news on Pope, Holy See, and Catholic Church worldwide
